author: CozzehPvP_
body:
Hello, this is CozzehPvP_ and I got banned for Anti - Knockback.. Now I'd never hack and i didnt, I was low in internet I had 1 bar so I was laggy now My brother sheamus4414 knows I couldn't hack and a little Proof, me showing my versions folder

Versons Folder: http://gyazo.com/be323e893730f42d93b3dfbb1d56f232
 
I am pretty good at PvP so I really have no reason to hack. I wouldn't hack on Avicus not in the long time I have been playing Avicus, I have no reason, no necessity and no stupidity to hack on Avicus or any server in general,

Your Sincerly,
- CozzehPvP_

[15/03/2015 1:28:26 AM | Edited 1:30:18 AM] CozzehPvP_ | Admin/Manager | RCTCraft: Bye Bye $100 xD
[15/03/2015 1:34:44 AM] CozzehPvP_ | Admin/Manager | RCTCraft: Is their any way I could Transfer my Rank?

[15/03/2015 1:36:36 AM] 99250: Erm
[15/03/2015 1:36:44 AM] 99250: You could try
[15/03/2015 1:37:05 AM] 99250: Talk to senior staff or email - support@avicus.net
